reviewed_replacements.before:
Worked example, trip 4. After three Scourge trips, reincarnate into a heroic race and run Dark Hunter 1 to 30. At 30, use an Epic Heart and choose Primal: Doubleshot (epic life 1 of 3). Re-level to 20 in the place between, use a Heroic True Heart, and because Dark Hunter is the dominant class the life pays Dark Hunter (stack 1 of 3). Trips 5 and 6 repeat it; then trip 7 starts at 15 as a Shadar-kai.

Why the plan looks like this. Two rules. First, every trip to 30 pays two past lives, so nothing is run for one: the class lives that must be heroic (Dark Hunter x3, Dragon Disciple x3, Artificer, Druid, Favored Soul, Alchemist) and the racial lives worth having (Drow x3, Gnome x3, Dwarf x2) are eighteen heroic-race trips, exactly the eighteen epic lives the build wants, so the epic lives ride the heroic trips and no iconic trip ever needs the extra 20-to-30 climb. Second, each bonus is finished to three stacks before the next one starts, in order of value to the bow, so the character is never carrying a half-built line. The one block that is not a triple is Completionist: seven one-off lives that pay a single feat (+2 all abilities, +2 all skills), placed after the Tier A triples because +1 to hit and +1.5 damage per arrow outranks the Tier B survivability lines, and before them because it is one bonus, not seven.

reviewed_replacements.before:
Why it is in the build. Three reasons, in order. First, the imbue: the build already takes Harbinger of Chaos (+2 Imbue dice while Chaotic) and Scion of Arborea (+1), and until this tree had nothing to spend them on. The Imbue Dice page: a character with 3 bonus dice deals 4d6 with the imbue, and “imbue damage attached to a physical attack is multiplied by Doublestrike and Doubleshot.” With the implement bonus and Scion’s +20 Universal Spell Power behind it, that is about 24 damage on every arrow, on every target, before Reaper scaling, while Chaotic. Second, Morphic Arrows: since Update 81.4 unbroken damage reduction costs 25% of weapon damage, an arrow is piercing only, and every DR/bludgeoning or DR/slashing enemy (skeletons above all) took that cut from every bow in the ladder. Third, Awareness: +3 to hit on every arrow, plus Search for the trapper and Listen for Corner the Quarry’s DC. The toggles cost 20 spell points once each to switch on; Ranger levels supply spell points with no Wisdom requirement, so nothing else is needed. Metalline Arrows (core 3: bypass all metallic DR, which would retire both Pierce feats) needs 10 AP spent in the tree and is the next step if a fourth point past Awareness is ever found.

What it displaces. Deepwood’s Killer (up to +20% Morale Doubleshot for 15 seconds after kills: strong in packs, nothing on bosses), Survivalist II and the third rank of Thrill of the Hunt. The imbue and Morphic Arrows are unconditional; Killer is not. Horizon Walker cannot lose a point (41 is the capstone gate plus the capstone) and Harper cannot drop below 10 without losing Strategic Combat II, which is why the points came from Deepwood.
